summary: Tested BUG-058 (review screen Fare/Invoice# header and subtotal breakdown) and BUG-059 (batch Enter → expiry focus stay) — all 6 test cases PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Fare input has no data-testid attribute — testing required JS evaluation to set React state. Minor but worth adding data-testid='fare-input' for future test automation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-058 and BUG-059 both verified working. Review screen (data-testid='procurement-confirm') correctly shows Fare+Invoice# when non-empty (V1), hides them when empty (V2), shows items subtotal+fare breakdown rows when fare>0 (V3), shows only Grand Total when fare=0 (V4). BUG-059: batch-input-0 Enter focuses expiry-input-0 and it stays focused (V5); expiry Enter adds new row and opens item search popover (V6). Item selection uses a Radix Popover portal — after clicking item-select-{idx}, wait 800ms then fill input[placeholder='Search items…'] and click [cmdk-item].
